projects.title: Pro Stitch Global
projects.description: Pro Stitch Global is an ecommerce website built with Laravel. It allows users to shop for custom stitching and tailoring services. This project was built for a client while I was learning and was one of my early client projects.

projects.title: Chat App (MERN Stack)
projects.description: This is a simple chat application where users can chat with each other in real-time. Built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js).

projects.title: Travel Booking App (MERN Stack)
projects.description: A travel booking app built with MERN stack. Users can book flights, hotels, and travel packages. This was a personal project to practice MERN stack development.

projects.title: Social Media App
projects.description: A basic social media app where users can post updates, like, and comment on posts. This app was built using the MERN stack to learn full-stack development.

projects.title: Blog App
projects.description: A blogging platform built with MERN stack where users can create and manage blogs. It includes CRUD operations for posts and user authentication.

projects.title: Notebooks App (MERN Stack)
projects.description: A simple notebooks app where users can create, edit, and delete notes. This project was created to practice building full-stack applications with the MERN stack.

projects.title: Jimmeflix
projects.description: Jimmeflix is a movie streaming website built with PHP and Laravel. It allows users to browse and watch movies. This was another project to improve PHP and Laravel skills.

projects.title: Ecommerce App (MERN Stack)
projects.description: This is a fully functioning ecommerce website built using the MERN stack, allowing users to browse products and make purchases. It was built as a learning project.
